final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS c1, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS c2 FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY o.mktnote), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS c1 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c2 - s2.c1 AS c3 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.c1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c2 > s2.c1) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3) FROM s3
